channel.title: Giant Reseller Phone System addon releases
channel.description: New versions of the Giant Reseller Phone System addon for WHMCS.

item.title: Giant Reseller Phone System addon 3.0.1
item.description:
• Checkout: the numbers and seats options are now found however the product names them ("Telephone Number(s)", "Phone Numbers", "Extensions/Users" and the names in the settings all work), so the number picker and the minutes panel appear on products imported from Giant
  • Checkout: the "Telephone Numbers (DIDs)" box imported from Giant's product is hidden, since the picker fills the numbers in
  • Checkout: when numbers cannot be offered (no numbers option, or no area codes from the API) the page says so in its source and the activity log, instead of showing nothing
  • Billing and Leaks use the same option matching for the billed seats and numbers

Downloads: PHP 7.4, PHP 8.1, PHP 8.2, PHP 8.3, PHP 8.4

item.title: Giant API: UK VoIP Reseller Provisioning & Addon Module 2.0.1
item.description:
• Automated monthly call billing, custom call bundle packages, and automatic creation of the custom fields and configurable options the module needs
  • Client area: live call logs, Zerotouch hardware auto-provisioning, SMS logs and outbound SMS, and management of hunt lists, telephones, IVR menus, extensions, call queues, forwarding destinations, short numbers, number purchasing and voicemail

Giant API: UK VoIP Reseller Provisioning & Addon Module, released through the WHMCS Marketplace.

item.title: Giant API: UK VoIP Reseller Provisioning & Addon Module 1.1
item.description:
• Zerotouch hardware provisioning
  • Fewer custom fields needed to provision a service
  • Virtual Landline product for resellers

Giant API: UK VoIP Reseller Provisioning & Addon Module, released through the WHMCS Marketplace.

item.title: Giant API: UK VoIP Reseller Provisioning & Addon Module 1.0
item.description:

Giant API: UK VoIP Reseller Provisioning & Addon Module, released through the WHMCS Marketplace.
